3.original_instruction: Visit said Haijara Greg inside the rogue guild, go down the stairs to the rogue job change npc and continue going left. Up towards the beds, there's a secret wall passage.

If you have learned this skill as a Rogue and have since transcended, proceed to step 3 and speak to Haijara Greg to regain the skill instantly.

Если вы уже изучали это умение как Rogue, а затем прошли перерождение, переходите к этапу 3: поговорите с Haijara Greg, чтобы сразу вернуть умение.

10.original_instruction: Here is where the fun starts. The players have 5 minutes before they are kicked out. Kienna will appear in one second as the room warns, and the player must walk right up 1 cell next to her before she hides, or she will disappear and the player will be sent back to the middle of the room to repeat.
10.full_en: Here is where the fun starts. The players have 5 minutes before they are kicked out. Kienna will appear in one second as the room warns, and the player must walk right up 1 cell next to her before she hides, or she will disappear and the player will be sent back to the middle of the room to repeat.
10.full_ru: На испытание отведено 5 минут, затем персонажа выгоняют. После предупреждения комнаты Kienna появится через одну секунду. Подойдите к ней на 1 клетку до того, как она спрячется; иначе она исчезнет, вас вернут в центр комнаты и попытку придётся повторить.
10.short_ru: За 5 минут испытания подходите к Kienna на 1 клетку до её исчезновения.
10.short_en: Within the 5-minute test, approach to within 1 cell of Kienna before she disappears.

actions.condition: If she disappears before approach; not a required repeat after success.

11.original_instruction: Upon successfully walking up to her she will prompt the player. Reminiscent of the battle dwarf of the God Items Quest for level 4 weapons, you must choose the right options: Block her from the left, Block her from the right, or Block her moving backward. Experience says that after a successful block it is wise to choose a different option. To pass the test, the player must perform above grade C+. Upon success she will return the player to Thor Greg. He will tell the player to go back to his father to finish learning the skill.
11.full_en: Upon successfully walking up to her she will prompt the player. Reminiscent of the battle dwarf of the God Items Quest for level 4 weapons, you must choose the right options: Block her from the left, Block her from the right, or Block her moving backward. Experience says that after a successful block it is wise to choose a different option. To pass the test, the player must perform above grade C+. Upon success she will return the player to Thor Greg. He will tell the player to go back to his father to finish learning the skill.
11.full_ru: Если вы успели подойти, она предложит выбор. Как в испытании боевого гнома из God Items Quest для оружия уровня 4, выбирайте подходящий вариант: Block her from the left, Block her from the right или Block her moving backward. Источник советует менять вариант после успешного блока; это рекомендация, а не гарантированный алгоритм. Требуется оценка выше C+. После успеха она вернёт вас к Thor Greg; он направит вас обратно к отцу завершить обучение.
11.short_ru: Блокируйте движения Kienna и получите оценку выше C+; затем вернитесь через Thor Greg к отцу.
11.short_en: Block Kienna's movements and score above C+; then return via Thor Greg to the father.

12.original_instruction: Upon returning to Haijara Greg to master the skill, a thief in the shape of a guard steals his book. The player must once again do the test, doing a similar blocking session, far easier, in which it tells you to watch the auras the thief displays and respond by picking the according direction, doing so successfully will get the book back. Once completed, talk to Haijara, and he will give you Close Confine.

The player must once again do the test, doing a similar blocking session, far easier, in which it tells you to watch the auras the thief displays and respond by picking the according direction, doing so successfully will get the book back. Once completed, talk to Haijara, and he will give you Close Confine.
12.full_ru: Когда вы вернётесь к Haijara Greg для завершения обучения, thief в облике стражника украдёт его book. Пройдите ещё одно похожее, более лёгкое испытание блокирования: следите за аурами thief и выбирайте соответствующее направление, чтобы вернуть book. После успеха поговорите с Haijara: он обучит вас Close Confine.
12.short_ru: Верните book в повторном испытании по аурам; затем у Haijara Greg изучите Close Confine.

reviews.detail: Only a character who already learned Close Confine as Rogue and then transcended can regain it instantly at stage 3. First-time learning retains the father/sons sequence, queued five-minute Kienna trial and a separate aura-guided book-recovery trial. No fixed block sequence, aura mapping, exact C+ numeric threshold or second-trial timer is invented.

cmd_fild04 302,177 is Antonio Jr.'s building entrance, not Jay Greg's indoor position. Louis Greg's building has a relative location only. Thor Greg is recommended but not the only proven possible starting son. Haijara is a contextual shortened reference to Haijara Greg. Three Kienna options are situational, not a mandatory sequence of universally correct answers. Passwords are exact, but the interface input mode is unknown.

routes.condition: If Close Confine was learned as Rogue before transcending, talk to Haijara Greg at stage 3 to regain it instantly; skip ordinary learning trials. Evidence is retained in the stage requirement and source addition.
